name: item
title: Item
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A row primitive pairing media, title, description and actions in one aligned layout. Use it to build list rows, notification entries and search results.
docs: Named export: ItemBlock. `media` and `actions` take arbitrary nodes, so an avatar and a button drop straight in. Variants: default | compact | card | bordered. Passing `onClick` makes the whole row interactive.
